name: PixelPay Payment Gateway for WooCommerce
author: joshepw

sections.description:
This plugin allows your WordPress site to accept credit and debit card payments through PixelPay. Compatible with WooCommerce.

Settings Data

Extract the control panel credentials from your PixelPay account here https://pixelpay.com/.

External Services

This plugin connects to the PixelPay SDK for secure transaction processing.

It is needed to authorize and complete transactions initiated through your checkout.
It transmits transaction related data for payment processing. No personal customer data is stored.
It supports 3D Secure authentication to verify cardholder identity and reduce fraud during online payments.
Payment operations are handled in compliance with PCI DSS requirements.

This service is provided by PixelPay
